raw_segments.text: It had not occurred to me before that he had led up to the theme for the purpose of clearing
it out of our way, but we were so much the lighter and easier for having broached it
that I now perceived this to be the case.
We were very gay and sociable, and I asked him in the course of conversation what he
He replied, a capitalist, an insurer of ships.
I suppose he saw me glancing about the room in search of some tokens of shipping, or capital,
for he added, in the city.
